lines.text: On the Sabbath at a leading Pharisee's house, Jesus healed a man with dropsy and sent him away.
Jesus asked who would not pull a son or ox from a pit on the Sabbath; none could answer.
Jesus taught guests at a wedding banquet to sit in the middle place so the host would move them up.
Jesus told him to invite the poor, crippled, lame and blind, and he would be repaid at the resurrection.
The angry master sent his servant to the temple courts to bring in the poor, crippled, blind and lame.
